people.imagined: Midday on the casting floor of the mountain pavilion. She has just thrown back her head and laughed at a joke from a caster, loud enough to carry. The three blue jade pendants swing at her throat and click against each other. Her forearms are bare and shining with old burn scars. Behind the laugh her eyes are tired.
people.subject: The moment: at noon on a glowing casting terrace she has thrown her head back in a loud laugh, mouth open, caught mid-sound, one hand raised as if to slap a shoulder. Face: most important, three blue jade pendants on one cord hang at her throat against the collar, glowing deep lapis blue, and her bare forearms show pale glossy burn scars. A broad, stout face with full cheeks, tanned a ruddy bronze; small bright dark eyes creased into half-moons; heavy straight brows; a short wide nose; a wide mouth with strong teeth; the eyes stay watchful and tired while the mouth laughs. Hair: black with a streak of iron grey at the left temple, piled in a thick crown knot held by a flat bronze pin and a small crown of tiny gold bells. Body: short, broad and stout, shoulders square. Clothing: layered bronze-gold brocade, three crossed collars, the round outer collar embroidered with gold bells and sound-ripples; wide sleeves of bronze-brown silk pushed back above the elbows with gold cords; a heavy sash hung with a small bronze bell and gold tassels. Hands and objects: her scarred forearms bare, one hand lifted open; the three slender drop-shaped pendants on a red cord. Power: a strong aura of ochre earth-light and silver-gold metal motes rises around her shoulders, and the bells of her crown shiver without a wind. Background: a blurred hall of hanging bronze bells in drifting golden mist. Light: warm spirit-light from the upper left, an orange furnace glow on her right cheek, a bright rim along the brocade. Expression: a big warm laugh, bright and a little hard, tiredness behind it.

people.imagined: Late evening on the casting floor, after the others have gone. He stands by the great flat-ringing bell in its pit and has just rested his palm on its rim, not striking it. He tilts his right ear toward it because the left ear is deaf. The clay colour of his face matches the clay floor.
people.subject: The moment: alone at dusk beside an enormous dull bronze bell, he rests one open palm on its rim and turns his head so the right ear is toward it, listening. Face: most important, his whole face and neck are the colour of dry red clay, gaunt as a fired brick, and his left ear is a puckered, shrunken scrap of scarred flesh beside a closed ear hole. Hollow cheeks, a long jaw, a flat high forehead; deep-set small dull brown eyes under straight heavy brows; a long thin nose; thin colourless lips pressed shut. Hair: short black, cut close, held by a plain bronze band with a few tiny bells. Body: tall, gaunt, narrow-shouldered, stooped slightly. Clothing: an elder's robe of bronze-gold brocade over bronze-brown silk, three crossed collars, the round collar worked with gold sound-ripples, a clay-grey silk over-robe stiff with old clay dust falling in long folds; wide sleeves lifted from the wrists; a small bronze bell at the sash. Hands and objects: his right hand flat on the curved green-brown rim of the huge bell, fingers spread, the hand the same clay colour; the bell fills the lower right of the frame, its lip chipped. Power: faint concentric ripples of silver-gold light spread from his palm across the bell's skin, a few ochre motes drifting. Background: a dark hall of hanging bells in mist, the last orange of a banked furnace. Light: low warm spirit-light from the upper left, a dim orange glow below. Expression: quiet, still, absorbed, grief held without a flicker.

people.imagined: Dusk on the Cloud Bridge among the forty hanging bells. She has just raised her small hand bell and tilted her head, listening for the one that is wrong. On the new-moon nights she is not sure the answer comes from the wind.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk among rows of hanging bronze bells she holds a small hand bell by her ear and tilts her head to the left, listening. Face: a small, round, soft face on round shoulders; the head tipped sideways is the thing to read first. Fair brown skin with a few freckles, wide-set round dark eyes slightly lowered, brows high and thin, a small nose, a small closed mouth about to speak; faint lines of listening across the forehead. Hair: dark brown, in a low bun at the nape pinned by a small bronze pin with one tiny bell, a few loose wisps at the ear on the listening side, the ear bare. Body: small, round-shouldered, a little bent at the neck. Clothing: layered bronze-brown silk with two crossed collars and a round outer collar embroidered in thin gold bells, cuffs and hem edged in gold thread, a pale clay-grey gauze over-robe drifting behind her; wide sleeves to the wrist; a small bronze bell at the sash. Hands and objects: in her raised right hand a hand bell no bigger than a plum, bronze, held by its cord, and a chip of blue jade drilled and hung beside it, small and clearly blue. Power: a few silver-gold motes shiver in the air near the bell, a faint ring of light around its lip. Background: rows of larger bronze bells hanging against a violet and amber dusk, thin rope lines, soft mist. Light: soft amber spirit-light from the upper left, a faint glow on the jade. Expression: head tilted, eyes unfocused and listening, lips just parted, a small worried crease between the brows.

people.imagined: On the wharf in sea wind, morning. She holds the bell clapper in one fist like a club and a captain's book in the other, shouting down at a moored boat that its bell is a half tone flat. She is thinking of the boat she does not own.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy wharf in the morning she leans forward to shout at someone below the frame, a bronze bell clapper in one raised fist. Face: most important, a loud salt-tanned face, deeply weathered brown and creased, with white salt dried in the lines beside her eyes and a squint from looking at the sea. Wide jaw, strong chin, a broad nose peeling at the tip, a big mouth open in a shout showing a gap between the front teeth; thick black brows pulled down; sharp dark eyes. Hair: black streaked with grey, knotted at the back with a faded blue ribbon and a bronze pin, strands whipped across one cheek. Body: strong, wide shoulders, forward-leaning. Clothing: flowing bronze-brown and gold silk in two crossed collars, the round collar embroidered with gold bells, salt-stained at the hem but well cut; a clay-grey silk over-robe whipping in the wind; wide sleeves tied back to the elbow with cords, showing brown forearms; a cord of small bronze bells looped over one shoulder. Hands and objects: in her right fist a heavy bell clapper, a bronze ball on a short iron rod; in her left a thick cloth-bound ledger held against her hip. Power: a thin shimmer of pale water-blue and silver-gold motes curls in the sea wind about her fist. Background: blurred grey-blue sea, a ship's mast and rigging, a gull, sea mist. Light: bright cool silver sea-light from the upper left, a salty haze and soft rim light. Expression: a challenge, loud and warm, the eyes already far away.

people.imagined: Afternoon, the mould shed. He is bent over a half-packed mould and has just looked up at someone who asked him to be gentler. His back is bent like a bell yoke, he pays no heed, and his nails are grey with clay.
people.subject: The moment: bent far forward over a clay mould at the bottom of the frame, he lifts only his eyes to the viewer, unhurried. Face: most important, the deeply bent back and bowed head make his shoulders rise nearly to his ears, and his hands and nails are packed with grey clay. A long, hollowed, leathery face the brown of old pottery, deep vertical grooves in the cheeks, a heavy brow, small narrow pale brown eyes looking up from under the brow; a flat, thick nose; a thin, flat, unyielding mouth; thin grey stubble. Hair: sparse iron grey, cropped short, a clay smear in it, a bronze-brown silk band tied over the forehead. Body: short, hunched, thick hands. Clothing: layered bronze-brown silk with two crossed collars and a round collar embroidered in faded gold sound-ripples, grey with clay dust to the forearm; a clay-grey silk over-robe creased and soft with long use, wide sleeves knotted back; a small bronze bell at the sash. Hands and objects: both hands, clay-grey to the wrist, pressed on a half-packed mould, a round shell of damp clay the size of a barrel; a wooden paddle laid on it. Power: a faint ochre glow seeps up through the clay under his palms, a few amber motes among the dust. Background: a dim shed in drifting golden mist, blurred shelves of moulds, a shaft of dusty light. Light: warm spirit-light from the upper left, dust glittering in the air. Expression: flat, patient and unmoved, hard in the eyes.

people.imagined: Wharf office at the lot-drawing. He holds the jar of berth pebbles up at shoulder height and has already felt for the white ones with his thumb. A captain stands in front of him. He rocks slightly on his heels, as if the floor still moved.
people.subject: The moment: at a wharf lot-drawing he holds a stoneware jar up at shoulder height with one hand, his thumb inside the neck, and looks at the viewer with polite blankness. Face: a narrow tanned face, flat across the cheekbones, with a long upper lip and a small neat black moustache; eyes half closed with friendly sleepiness, pupils small and dark; a thin straight nose; a faint smile on one side only, held a moment too long, which is the thing that should read. Hair: black, oiled, parted at the side and drawn back into a topknot with a small bronze clasp at the nape. Body: lean, loose-shouldered, a slight sway as if on a deck, one hip dropped. Clothing: bronze-brown silk of good weave in two crossed collars, the round collar embroidered with fine gold bells, neat gold-edged cuffs; a clay-grey silk over-robe folded over one arm; a narrow cord of tiny bells at the collar and a bronze bell at the sash. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a brown stoneware jar with a narrow neck, small stones showing at the mouth, one white pebble pinched between thumb and forefinger; the left hand rests on a stack of papers bound with string. Power: a very faint silver-gold shimmer clings to the pebbles, no more. Background: blurred wharf planks and a ship's hull in pearly sea mist. Light: soft grey-silver morning glow from the front left, a pale rim along the silk. Expression: friendly, unreadable, a faint private smile.

people.imagined: A hot noon in midsummer on the caravan road. He wears the thick sheepskin coat and is complaining aloud to the cart driver about the heat, wiping his neck. Behind the complaint his eyes are counting the fittings in the cart.
people.subject: The moment: on a hot road at noon he has pulled a thick sheepskin coat open at the chest and is mopping his neck with a cloth, complaining, mouth in a grimace. Face: most important, a bulky sheepskin coat with curly cream wool at the collar and cuffs, far too warm for the sun, worn over his silks. A wide, red, sweating face, sunburnt and shiny; a broad nose; round dark eyes with the lids lowered, a quick sideways glance; a short brown beard with a few grey hairs; a wide mouth open mid-grumble, showing a missing tooth. Hair: brown, shaggy, falling over the ears and sweaty at the forehead, a bronze clasp holding a short knot. Body: stocky, heavy-set, a loose stance. Clothing: under the coat a bronze-brown silk robe in two crossed collars, the round collar open and embroidered with gold bells; a clay-grey silk sash rolled and tied at the belt; wide sleeves shoved up; a cord of small bronze bells across his chest. Hands and objects: his right hand wipes his neck with a rag; his left holds a bronze bell the size of a fist by its loop. Power: a thin silver-gold shimmer of metal qi plays on the bell's lip. Background: a blurred dry road, cart canvas, pale grass hills in a heat haze. Light: harsh bright gold sunlight from high on the left, deep shadow under the brow. Expression: loud and aggrieved on the surface, a shrewd sideways look underneath.

people.imagined: Night in the bell-keeper's shed above the Cloud Bridge. He lies awake fully dressed with his boots on, sitting up now, because the forty bells have begun answering something below. He listens. He has been told it is the wind.
people.subject: The moment: at night he sits bolt upright on a narrow bed with his boots still on, head turned toward a window, listening to something outside. Face: a thin, pale young face, the skin grey-white from sleeplessness with dark shadows under both eyes; wide-set dark brown eyes, whites showing above the iris; thin straight eyebrows lifted; a pointed chin, a small mouth held tight; a day-old wisp of beard on the chin. Hair: black, uncombed, sticking up on one side from the pillow, a bronze hairpin slipped half out. Body: wiry, narrow shoulders, upright and tense. Clothing: simple bronze-brown silk, dressed and belted though it is night, a round collar with a thread of gold bell embroidery, the plain graceful silk of a junior; dark laced travelling boots at the bottom of the frame; a cord of two small bells at his belt, wrapped in cloth to keep them quiet. Hands and objects: both hands grip the edge of the plank bed; a stub of candle in a dish glows beside him. Background: a dark wooden shed wall, a small window of deep blue moonless night, the dim shapes of hanging bells beyond with a faint silver mist. Light: a single candle from the lower left lights his face yellow, cold blue glow from the window, and the far bells give off a faint pale shimmer. Expression: alert, afraid and trying not to be.

people.imagined: Afternoon at the mould shed. She is carrying a full tray of moulds and her arms shake. A cough has just shaken her and she is holding it down so as not to drop the tray. She has coughed black since the third night.
people.subject: The moment: she carries a full tray of clay moulds in both arms against her chest, and her arms visibly tremble as she holds in a cough. Face: a thin, pale girl's face with sunken cheeks and a smudge of dark grey around the nostrils and the corners of the lips; large dark eyes, red at the rims, brows drawn together with effort; a narrow nose; a small cracked mouth pressed shut; the neck thin. Hair: black, plaited in one short braid over the shoulder with a bronze-brown ribbon, clay in the strands. Body: frail, thin shoulders, bent a little under the load, collarbones sharp above the neckline, wrists thin as reed stalks. Clothing: the simplest graceful bronze-brown silk of an outer disciple, plain round collar edged with one thread of gold, too big at the shoulders, clean; the sleeves dried grey with clay to the elbow on both forearms; a clay-grey silk sash. Hands and objects: a wooden tray loaded with six round grey clay moulds, gripped with both thin arms, the knuckles white. Background: a dim shed in soft golden mist with blurred shelves of grey half-packed moulds like stacked drums, a rough ladder against the wall. Light: dusty gold spirit-light slanting from the left, fine dust floating in it and giving her hair a pale grey halo. Expression: effortful and enduring, afraid to put it down.

people.imagined: Night at the pouring floor, alone. She has just stopped the pour of a bell and is holding the ladle, looking at the mould she is about to crack. Her knuckles are ground with red-gold dust, and her lip is bitten.
people.subject: The moment: at night she stands by a mould holding a long iron ladle with a spoonful of glowing metal still in it, her eyes fixed on a hairline crack just beginning in the clay. Face: a lean, hard-jawed, sun-browned face; a determined, slightly crooked mouth with the lower lip bitten; dark eyes narrowed in a stubborn glare; a thin scar through the left eyebrow; a faint sheen of sweat; the knuckles of the hand in the lower frame ground with fine red-gold dust, glinting. Hair: black, tied up in a high tight tail with a strip of scorched bronze-brown silk and a bronze pin. Body: strong, squared shoulders, short and wiry. Clothing: bronze-brown silk in two crossed collars, the round collar embroidered with gold bell and ripple motifs; a clay-grey silk over-robe with a small burnt hole near the hem; wide sleeves tied up above the elbow with gold cord; a leather glove on the left hand. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a long iron ladle; its bowl glows orange-yellow; the knuckles dusted red-gold. Power: the molten metal throws up a swirl of silver-gold and ember-orange motes that coil about her wrist. Background: dark floor, a big round clay mould half-sunk in sand, orange sparks, a rack of finished moulds at the left edge, drifting smoke. Light: hot orange glow from below and the right, rim light on the cheek, sparks rising past her shoulder as tiny orange points. Expression: stubborn, defiant, a decision in the jaw.

people.imagined: Morning on the packing floor. She twirls the coil of wool cord at her wrist without noticing, still a shepherd. She flinches at the sound of the head's bell down the hall, the old guilt of running at the pit.
people.subject: The moment: at a packing table in the morning she has stopped working and looks up toward a sound, with a coil of white wool cord round her left wrist turning in her fingers. Face: a round, wind-reddened country face with chapped cheeks; clear wide-set grey-green eyes; short stubby lashes; a snub nose with sunburn; a full mouth held slightly open; slight tension at the brow. Hair: light brown, in two short thick plaits tied with the same white wool, a few short strands escaping at the temples like unspun wool. Body: sturdy, short, strong forearms. Clothing: the simple graceful bronze-brown silk of a new outer disciple, a plain round collar with a single gold thread, clean and neat, a little large; pale dried clay on the forearms to the elbow; a clay-grey silk sash tied twice round. Hands and objects: the coil of undyed wool cord at her left wrist, three turns, with a loose end hanging; her right hand holds a wooden packing paddle with clay on it. Background: a blurred shed in soft mist, a mould half packed, a window with green grass hills; on the table behind her three small round moulds in a neat row and a bucket of grey slip. Light: soft pearly morning glow, a narrow bar of gold light crossing her cheek and the pale clay on her forearms. Expression: a flinch of attention, sad and ashamed beneath.

people.imagined: In the shadow of the scrap pile at night. She has a lump of stolen scrap bronze in her hand and is checking behind her. The half-moon burn on her thumb is the first thing anyone would see.
people.subject: The moment: in the dark at the corner of a scrap pile she has just palmed a lump of bronze and looks over her shoulder with a stiff face, caught mid-glance. Face: a plain, square, freckled farm girl's face, full cheeks and a stubborn chin; narrow dark eyes under straight brows, sharp and guarded; a short wide nose; a thin mouth set shut in a line; a sheen of nerves on the upper lip. Hair: dark brown, cut blunt at the jaw, with a clay-coloured streak. Body: sturdy, stocky, shoulders rounded forward as she crouches, one knee on the ground and the elbow tucked tight to her ribs. Clothing: the simplest graceful bronze-brown silk, round collar with one gold thread, clean, a clay-grey silk sash; clay dried on the forearms to the elbow. Hands and objects: in her right hand a lump of green-bronze scrap the size of an egg held close against her ribs; the thumb carries a clear half-moon burn scar, pink and glossy, held toward the viewer. Power: a few faint silver-gold motes stir toward the stolen bronze. Background: a dark pile of broken bronze pieces, blurred, a cracked bell mouth sticking out like a sleeping animal's ear, night sky and thin mist above. Light: thin cool silver moonlight from above left, a point of orange from a far furnace, a soft rim on her cheek. Expression: guarded and stubborn, ready to deny everything.

people.imagined: Midday on the casting floor. He leans a shoulder on a door and kicks it open without looking, carrying the great hammer, and grins at a bell he has not cast. He has a blister on every finger.
people.subject: The moment: at midday he shoves a heavy wooden door open with his shoulder, a great hammer slung on the other shoulder, grinning at someone off frame. Face: a broad, open, cheeky young face, tanned, with a wide mouth in an easy lopsided grin; a nose once broken and set slightly to the right; bright quick dark brown eyes; a few stubble hairs on the chin; sweat shining at the temples. Hair: short black, spiky, tied with a bronze-brown silk ribbon. Body: broad, big forearms, a lean-forward weight; his chest is bare in the open collar under sleeves cut off at the shoulder joint, tanned and sweaty. Clothing: bronze-brown silk in a loose crossed collar with gold bell embroidery at the border, the wide sleeves cut away at the shoulder, a clay-grey silk sash with a scorch mark; leather wristbands; the leading boot up on the door sill. Hands and objects: the right hand around a long-handled iron hammer with a head the size of two fists resting on his shoulder; every finger of the left hand, held against the door, has a round white blister on its tip. Power: a flicker of silver-gold qi runs along the hammer's head. Background: the bright doorway of a casting floor, glare, blurred bells, golden mist. Light: strong sunlight from the upper right-front with a bright rim of white along the shoulder, hair and the hammer's head. Expression: easy and cocky, mischief in the eyes.

people.imagined: A busy afternoon at the Bell Wharf. She has just polished a small bell against her sleeve and is holding it up to sell. The gold hoop in her ear flashes when she turns. She says it was a gift.
people.subject: The moment: at the wharf in the afternoon she holds up a freshly polished little bronze bell for a buyer with a sweet, salesperson's smile and her head tilted. Face: most important, a gold hoop earring as big as a coin in her left ear, bright and catching the light. A round, pretty face, olive-tanned, with plump cheeks; bright, rather close-set dark eyes with a calculating glint; arched, painted-looking brows; a small nose; full lips in a broad bright smile that does not move the eyes. Hair: glossy black, in a high knot with two loose curls at the ears and a red cord woven in, a small gold bell pin. Body: plump and compact, a confident lean. Clothing: finely woven bronze-brown and gold silk in two crossed collars, the round collar embroidered with gold bells and ripples, a bronze thread at the hem; a clean clay-grey gauze over-robe; a string of small bells on the sash. Hands and objects: a shining bronze hand bell the size of a lime held up between thumb and forefinger; the other hand cupped beneath it. Power: a sprinkle of silver-gold motes dances around the bell as she turns it. Background: blurred sunlit wharf, bright water, masts, a haze of gold. Light: bright sea-light from the left, a glint on the hoop and a soft rim along the gold embroidery. Expression: sweet, warm and smiling, her eyes a little too quick.

people.imagined: Twilight at a caravan halt. He sits on a cart rail with a spear across his knees, and scowls at the dark grass. The claw scar on his cheek tugs. He remembers the night the ward bell did not hold.
people.subject: The moment: at a caravan halt at twilight he stands watch on a cart, the shaft of a spear in his hand, frowning at the dark grass off frame. Face: most important, four parallel pale claw scars run down the left cheek from the eye to the jaw, ridged and bright against the tan, and pull the cheek when he frowns. A long, rawboned face, a strong jaw, short dark stubble; dark eyes narrowed, watchful; a straight nose; a firm mouth, the corner dragged down by the scar. Hair: short, black, dusty from the road, held by a bronze band. Body: tall, rangy, a warrior's easy readiness, weight on the left leg, the right foot on the cart's rim. Clothing: bronze-brown silk in two crossed collars with a round gold-embroidered collar, plain and clean; a dust-coloured silk travelling over-robe belted at the waist, wide sleeves bound at the wrist; a small bell wrapped in cloth at the collar. Hands and objects: a plain iron-headed spear held upright against his shoulder, the blade catching the last light, his fingers touching it without looking. Power: faint ochre and silver-gold motes rise from the spearhead like dust, stirred by an unseen wind. Background: blurred wagon canvas and a darkening steppe sky, a faint line of pale grass, a thin smoke from a cooking fire, drifting mist. Light: the last gold light from the left, deep shadow on the scarred cheek. Expression: wary, alert, set hard.

people.imagined: Bright morning before the tuning. He spins a bell clapper between his fingers, bored, unable to sit still, rocking on his heels with a grin. The tide comes through the rock arch at his home twice a day, and he cannot wait for either.
people.subject: The moment: on a bright morning he flips a small bronze clapper between his fingers as he bounces on his toes, grinning straight at the viewer, bored and unable to keep still. Face: a long, lively, sun-brown face with a big grin showing a chipped front tooth; light brown eyes with laughing creases; a snub nose; thin, mobile brows raised high; pointed ears, the left slightly higher than the right and carrying a small bronze ring that is too large for it. Hair: tousled sandy-brown, falling in his eyes, tied up by a bit of red silk string on top. Body: thin and restless, long in the leg and short in the body, so his bounce makes his whole frame sway like a reed. Clothing: simple graceful bronze-brown silk with a round collar and a thread of gold, the wide sleeves pushed up over forearms dusted with pale clay; a clay-grey silk sash tied slightly askew; a darker bronze-brown inner robe showing at the collar; a loop of red thread knotted round the left wrist. Hands and objects: a small bronze clapper, a ball on a stem, tumbling between the first and second fingers of the right hand, caught in blur; a cord of tiny bells at the belt. Background: blurred, a row of unlit casting furnaces under a lean-to, bright wharf stairs beyond, a pearly sky and a gull. Light: bright airy morning glow with a clean white sky behind. Expression: restless and gleeful, a lazily mischievous grin that never quite settles.

people.imagined: Late afternoon on the Cloud Bridge, sun on her face. She blinks slowly like a cat, bell mallet loose in her hand, and might doze where she stands. She sleeps through the new-moon ringing and is the only one who does.
people.subject: The moment: in late afternoon sun she stands with a mallet hanging loosely from one hand, eyes half closed, blinking slowly, utterly relaxed. Face: a soft, calm, rounded face with fair, sun-warmed skin; heavy-lidded almond-shaped dark eyes half shut, long dark lashes on her cheek; faint smile lines and a small crease at the corner of each eye where she smiles in her sleep; a small straight nose; full relaxed lips with a faint upturn; a trace of sleepiness. Hair: black, in a loose long braid over one shoulder, a small bronze bell tied on its end. Body: soft-built, slow, slouched at ease, shoulders low and loose, weight on one hip as if she might fold down onto the planks. Clothing: neat loose bronze-brown silk, two crossed collars with the round collar slightly open, embroidered with gold bells, a clay-grey silk sash, sleeves to the wrist. Hands and objects: a felt-headed wooden bell mallet hanging from her right hand; the left hand lightly resting on a bronze bell that glows in the sun. Power: a slow drift of soft silver-gold motes and a faint ochre warmth circle her like a sleeping cat's halo. Background: the Cloud Bridge's rope rails running off in perspective, hung with forty round bronze bells, against a warm gold sky with a flock of small birds and light mist. Light: warm gold afternoon spirit-light from the left, lighting the eyelids. Expression: sleepy, serene, content, as a cat in the sun.

people.imagined: Beside the furnace, face lit orange. He pumps the great bellows with a cheerful grin; the heat has eaten his eyebrows. He is happy to be useful and has no idea he is the best fire on the floor.
people.subject: The moment: at a furnace he hauls on a long bellows handle, his face lit orange, smiling broadly with the effort, happy to be useful. Face: most important, he has no eyebrows at all, only a smooth shiny brow with a few singed stubs, which makes the round face look permanently surprised. A round, ruddy, sweating boy's face with large, bright, light-brown eyes, a stub nose, a wide open smile, and soot smudges on both cheeks. Hair: short and black, singed at the front into an uneven edge; two stiff little tufts are all that is left of his fringe, brown at the tips. Body: slight and thin-armed, wiry from work. Clothing: a sleeveless jacket of clean bronze-brown silk over a pale inner robe, thin arms bare to the shoulder, a simple round collar with a gold thread; a clay-grey silk sash far too long for him, scorched at the end and tied with a double knot at the back; a wet cloth wound round his left wrist to guard against sparks. This is the plain working dress of a boy, kept clean. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round the wooden handle of a big leather bellows, knuckles pink with heat. Power: the fire answers him, its flames leaning toward him and a swirl of bright red-orange motes streaming up past his hair, stronger than a boy of his rank should show. Background: a roaring furnace mouth, white-orange, with sparks, blurred; at the right edge a second furnace glows dull red, a stack of split charcoal against the dark wall. Light: strong orange firelight from the right and below, with a rim of light on the cheek. Expression: cheerful and absorbed, delighted by the work, the grin wide and unselfconscious.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the man at the moment of his defining act: the winter of 1121, at the lip of the pit, calm, one jade pendant in hand, about to order the pour of the great bell. He believed the best bell is never struck.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a man standing calmly at the lip of a casting pit in winter, a single carved jade pendant held at chest height. Face: a long, mild, thoughtful face, fine-boned, pale brown; calm, patient eyes of soft brown with a deep, kind look; a straight nose; a gentle closed mouth with a faint trace of a smile; a short trimmed beard, black with a few silver hairs; the lines of a craftsman who squints at small work. Hair: black with grey at the temples, tied up in a knot with a bronze pin and a small crown of tiny bells, drawn in faded gold. Body: slender, upright, soft-shouldered. Clothing: a founder's robe of bronze-gold brocade over bronze-brown silk, three crossed collars, the round collar embroidered with bells and sound-ripples in faded gold, a pale winter wrap of fine wool-silk over the shoulders; wide sleeves, one hand tucked inside; a small bronze bell at the sash. Hands and objects: a single blue-green jade pendant carved as a drop, held up by its red cord between the finger and thumb of the right hand. Power: a ring of pale gold ripples spreads around him, so dim it is nearly lost in the paint. Background: a wash of pale grey, the faint outline of a huge bell and cold mist. Light: faint, even and pale, as if from old silk. Expression: calm, gentle, and certain.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the ship-bell ringer on the deck of Lận Viễn Phàm's first boat in 1158, wind in her face, one hand on the ship's bell, ready to ring it past the edge of the charts.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a woman on a ship's deck in a high wind, one hand on a bell, her chin lifted toward the horizon. Face: a brave, bright, slightly freckled face, windburnt pink on the cheeks; wide, clear light brown eyes squinting at distance; a quick open mouth in a half smile; a straight small nose; stray hair whipped across one cheek. Hair: dark brown, tied back in a long tail that streams sideways in the wind, a small bronze bell tied at its end. Body: slim, sturdy, braced at the rail. Clothing: bronze-brown silk in two crossed collars, the round collar embroidered with faded gold bells and waves, belted and kilted up for deck work, wide sleeves tight at the wrists with gold cord, a sea-grey silk scarf streaming from the neck; a clay-grey over-robe laid aside. Hands and objects: her right hand on a small bronze ship's bell hanging from a post, the rope in her fist; her left holds the rail, a coil of tarred rope over the forearm, her fingernails cut short and square from rope work. Power: faint rings of silver-gold shimmer spread from the bell, hardly more than a stain in the paint. Background: a faded pale grey-blue sky and sea, a sail edge, no land; far behind her the faded mast of the ship leans against a thin grey horizon with a single seabird. Light: soft, faint, even light, as if from old silk. Expression: bright, eager eyes fixed on the horizon, chin high, a half-smile that is bold and a little reckless.
